display_name: Ascend 950PR (commercial pilot-run binning of Ascend 910B silicon)
notes: Ground truth: 'Ascend 950PR' is a commercial/tender designation (Pilot Run / Project Reference), not an independent microarchitecture. The physical die is an Ascend 910B variant (DaVinci v2): every pool capacity, bank rule, alignment, channel bandwidth/latency, dtype throughput and synchronization invariant is inherited verbatim from ascend910b. The only fact this profile adds is system-level binning metadata. No independent HBM calibration is on file: hbm_bandwidth_gbps is inherited from the 910B manifest and must not be quoted as a 950PR-specific measurement. Downstream tools must resolve this profile to silicon-identical behaviour with ascend910b and only report the distinct core count.
